question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"enjoy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb **'enjoy'** means to experience pleasure or satisfaction from something. ((किसी वस्‍तु का) आनंद लेना) • **Example**: *I **enjoy**__ listening to music while I work.* • It is the most appropriate option for the blank as it fits grammatically and contextually. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct passage: Nainital has a __beautiful__ lake. Tourists come from far and wide to __**enjoy**__ boating here. There is a skating place behind it. People who skate here say that the ride seems to go round with them. Evenings are also pleasant here. The ______ 3 ______ of the electric lights looks as if they are dancing in the ripples of the lake. Truly, Nainital is an ______ 4 ______ city of ______ 5 ______ beauty. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1,** 'adore', **means to love or admire someone or something deeply. (स्‍नेह और आदर की भावना से देखना) • Option 3, **'celebrate', **means to mark a special occasion or event. (किसी विशेष अवसर पर उत्‍सव मनाना, समारोह करना) • Option 4, **'appreciate',** means to recognize the value or worth of something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के गुण पहचानना और उन्‍हें महत्व देना; रसास्‍वादन करना) 44:Td97, The correct answer is **"reflection."**
